newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Spector, Nashua in $5 mln mail order sales deal.
newsitem.headline: Spector, Nashua in $5 mln mail order sales deal.

text.p: Belgian film finisher Spector Photo Group said on Friday it had struck a deal worth about $5 million to buy the U.S. Nashua Corporation's European mail order photographic business.
Spector said in a statement the deal covered Nashua's mail order business in France, Belgium, Spain and the Netherlands which are mainly conducted under the name of Maxicolor.

It said the move was in line with its strategic policy of expanding its European mail order business, adding that the deal would allow it to use the full capacity of Racine's new laboratory and build on profitability.
